OpMemoryModel Logical GLSL450
OpEntryPoint Geometry %main "main" %gl_in %worldPos %normal %color %gl_Position %outColor %_
OpExecutionMode %main InputTrianglesAdjacency
OpExecutionMode %main OutputTriangleStrip
OpExecutionMode %main OutputVertices 3
OpExecutionMode %main Invocations 1

%ext_inst_GLSL_std_450 = OpExtInstImport "GLSL.std.450"

; All types
%void = OpTypeVoid
%bool = OpTypeBool
%int = OpTypeInt 32 1
%uint = OpTypeInt 32 0
%float = OpTypeFloat 32

%v3float = OpTypeVector %float 3
%v4float = OpTypeVector %float 4
%mat4float = OpTypeMatrix %v4float 4

%uint_0 = OpConstant %uint 0
%uint_1 = OpConstant %uint 1
%uint_2 = OpConstant %uint 2
%uint_3 = OpConstant %uint 3
%uint_4 = OpConstant %uint 4
%uint_5 = OpConstant %uint 5
%uint_6 = OpConstant %uint 6 ; Array size for InputTrianglesAdjacency

%float_0_0 = OpConstant %float 0.0
%float_0_2 = OpConstant %float 0.2
%float_0_8 = OpConstant %float 0.8
%float_1_0 = OpConstant %float 1.0
%float_3_0 = OpConstant %float 3.0

%v3float_1_1_1 = OpConstantComposite %v3float %float_1_0 %float_1_0 %float_1_0

; gl_PerVertex_in
%gl_PerVertex_in = OpTypeStruct %v4float
OpMemberDecorate %gl_PerVertex_in 0 BuiltIn Position
OpDecorate %gl_PerVertex_in Block
%arr_pv_in = OpTypeArray %gl_PerVertex_in %uint_6
%ptr_Input_arr_pv_in = OpTypePointer Input %arr_pv_in
%gl_in = OpVariable %ptr_Input_arr_pv_in Input

; gl_PerVertex_out
%ptr_Output_v4float = OpTypePointer Output %v4float
%gl_PerVertex_out = OpTypeStruct %v4float
OpMemberDecorate %gl_PerVertex_out 0 BuiltIn Position
OpDecorate %gl_PerVertex_out Block
%ptr_Output_gl_PerVertex_out = OpTypePointer Output %gl_PerVertex_out
%gl_Position = OpVariable %ptr_Output_gl_PerVertex_out Output

; User-defined inputs (arrays of size 6)
%ptr_Input_v3float = OpTypePointer Input %v3float
%arr_v3float_6 = OpTypeArray %v3float %uint_6
%ptr_Input_arr_v3float_6 = OpTypePointer Input %arr_v3float_6

OpDecorate %worldPos Location 0
%worldPos = OpVariable %ptr_Input_arr_v3float_6 Input

OpDecorate %normal Location 1
%normal = OpVariable %ptr_Input_arr_v3float_6 Input

OpDecorate %color Location 2
%color = OpVariable %ptr_Input_arr_v3float_6 Input

; User-defined output
%ptr_Output_v3float = OpTypePointer Output %v3float
OpDecorate %outColor Location 0
%outColor = OpVariable %ptr_Output_v3float Output

; UBO "test 41" layout (set=0, binding=0)
%_struct_41 = OpTypeStruct %mat4float %mat4float %mat4float %v3float %v3float %v4float
OpMemberDecorate %_struct_41 0 Offset 0 ; model
OpMemberDecorate %_struct_41 1 Offset 64 ; view
OpMemberDecorate %_struct_41 2 Offset 128 ; proj
OpMemberDecorate %_struct_41 3 Offset 192 ; lightPos
OpMemberDecorate %_struct_41 4 Offset 208 ; cameraPos
OpMemberDecorate %_struct_41 5 Offset 224 ; params
OpDecorate %_struct_41 Block
%ptr_Uniform__struct_41 = OpTypePointer Uniform %_struct_41
OpDecorate %_ DescriptorSet 0
OpDecorate %_ Binding 0
%_ = OpVariable %ptr_Uniform__struct_41 Uniform ; UBO instance

%ptr_Uniform_mat4float = OpTypePointer Uniform %mat4float
%ptr_Uniform_v3float = OpTypePointer Uniform %v3float
%ptr_Uniform_v4float = OpTypePointer Uniform %v4float

; Access chains for UBO members
%_model_ptr = OpAccessChain %ptr_Uniform_mat4float %_ %uint_0
%_view_ptr = OpAccessChain %ptr_Uniform_mat4float %_ %uint_1
%_proj_ptr = OpAccessChain %ptr_Uniform_mat4float %_ %uint_2
%_lightPos_ptr = OpAccessChain %ptr_Uniform_v3float %_ %uint_3
%_cameraPos_ptr = OpAccessChain %ptr_Uniform_v3float %_ %uint_4
%_params_ptr = OpAccessChain %ptr_Uniform_v4float %_ %uint_5

; Function main
%main = OpFunction %void None %void_fn
%entry = OpLabel
%model = OpLoad %mat4float %_model_ptr
%view = OpLoad %mat4float %_view_ptr
%proj = OpLoad %mat4float %_proj_ptr
%lightPos = OpLoad %v3float %_lightPos_ptr
%cameraPos = OpLoad %v3float %_cameraPos_ptr
; %params = OpLoad %v4float %_params_ptr ; not used in current logic

; Access worldPos for p0, p2, p4
%p0_ptr = OpAccessChain %ptr_Input_v3float %worldPos %uint_0
%p0 = OpLoad %v3float %p0_ptr
%p2_ptr = OpAccessChain %ptr_Input_v3float %worldPos %uint_2
%p2 = OpLoad %v3float %p2_ptr
%p4_ptr = OpAccessChain %ptr_Input_v3float %worldPos %uint_4
%p4 = OpLoad %v3float %p4_ptr

; Compute p2-p0 and p4-p0
%p2_minus_p0 = OpFSub %v3float %p2 %p0
%p4_minus_p0 = OpFSub %v3float %p4 %p0

; Compute cross product: N = cross(p2-p0, p4-p0)
%N_unnormalized = OpExtInst %v3float %ext_inst_GLSL_std_450 Cross %p2_minus_p0 %p4_minus_p0

; Normalize N
%N = OpExtInst %v3float %ext_inst_GLSL_std_450 Normalize %N_unnormalized

; Light direction L = vec3(1, 1, 1)
%L = OpCopyObject %v3float %v3float_1_1_1

; Compute diffuse = max(dot(N, L), 0.0)
%dot_NL = OpDot %float %N %L
%diffuse = OpExtInst %float %ext_inst_GLSL_std_450 FMax %dot_NL %float_0_0

; Base color = average of color[0], color[2], color[4]
%color0_ptr = OpAccessChain %ptr_Input_v3float %color %uint_0
%color0 = OpLoad %v3float %color0_ptr
%color2_ptr = OpAccessChain %ptr_Input_v3float %color %uint_2
%color2 = OpLoad %v3float %color2_ptr
%color4_ptr = OpAccessChain %ptr_Input_v3float %color %uint_4
%color4 = OpLoad %v3float %color4_ptr

%color_sum = OpFAdd %v3float %color0 %color2
%color_sum_2 = OpFAdd %v3float %color_sum %color4
%v3float_3_0 = OpConvertSToF %v3float %uint_3 ; Convert 3 to v3float(3.0, 3.0, 3.0)
%baseColor = OpFDiv %v3float %color_sum_2 %v3float_3_0

; Final color = base * (0.2 + 0.8 * diffuse)
%mul_0_8_diffuse = OpFMul %float %float_0_8 %diffuse
%add_0_2 = OpFAdd %float %float_0_2 %mul_0_8_diffuse
%finalColor = OpVectorTimesScalar %v3float %baseColor %add_0_2

; Emit the 3 triangle vertices with flat-shaded color
; Vertices at indices 0, 2, 4 of gl_in
%vertex_indices = OpConstantComposite %arr_uint_3 %uint_0 %uint_2 %uint_4

%idx_0_gl_in = OpAccessChain %ptr_Input_gl_PerVertex_in %gl_in %uint_0
%pos0_ptr = OpAccessChain %ptr_Input_v4float %idx_0_gl_in %uint_0
%pos0 = OpLoad %v4float %pos0_ptr
OpStore %gl_Position %pos0
OpStore %outColor %finalColor
OpEmitVertex

%idx_2_gl_in = OpAccessChain %ptr_Input_gl_PerVertex_in %gl_in %uint_2
%pos2_ptr = OpAccessChain %ptr_Input_v4float %idx_2_gl_in %uint_0
%pos2 = OpLoad %v4float %pos2_ptr
OpStore %gl_Position %pos2
OpStore %outColor %finalColor
OpEmitVertex

%idx_4_gl_in = OpAccessChain %ptr_Input_gl_PerVertex_in %gl_in %uint_4
%pos4_ptr = OpAccessChain %ptr_Input_v4float %idx_4_gl_in %uint_0
%pos4 = OpLoad %v4float %pos4_ptr
OpStore %gl_Position %pos4
OpStore %outColor %finalColor
OpEmitVertex

OpEndPrimitive

OpReturn
OpFunctionEnd
